title: Succession
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can succession become difficult in families, companies, or political systems?
Should leadership usually pass to someone from inside an organisation or to an outsider?
How early should a founder or leader start preparing a successor?
Can choosing a family member ever be fair if better-qualified candidates exist?
What makes a leadership transition feel legitimate to the people affected by it?
